name: Ansbach (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Ansbach (three blue fish on a white wavy bend on green).
history: Municipal flag of Ansbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ansbach arms — three fish on wavy bend
